subject: Next steps & scheduling: demo window + security/procurement intro

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & scheduling: demo window + security/procurement intro

Hi Julia — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Key goals you called out: reduce inference latency for customer-facing search, centralize model routing, and enforce VPC-isolation for regulated datasets.
- Primary stakeholders to include next: Tom (security) and procurement for commercial cadence.
- Next ask: schedule a 45–60 min technical demo/deep-dive where Dev (SE) walks through runtime, routing, and our security controls.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Tue 12/22 10:00–11:00
- Wed 12/23 09:30–10:15
- Thu 12/24 13:00–14:00

If you can confirm a preferred slot (or propose two alternatives), I’ll send a calendar invite and loop in any additional folks. I’ve attached our high-level SOW and the security questionnaire to help Tom/procurement triage in advance.

Attachments: initial-sow.pdf, security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Tom and procurement: looping you both in. Procurement contact is Lena Ortiz (lena.ortiz@acme.com) — I included procurement@acme.com for visibility.

WDYT about Wed 12/23 10:00–10:45 PT? That should work for Mark and me. If that slot is taken, Tue 12/22 at 10am is our backup.

Pre-reads: we'll take a look at the SOW and security questionnaire ahead of time; Tom, anything specific you want from Redwood before the demo?

Best,

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & scheduling: demo window + security/procurement intro

Thanks Julia — Wed 12/23 10:00 PT works on our side. I’ll block 45 minutes.

Proposed demo agenda (45 min):
1) 5m — Quick introductions & goals (Camila)
2) 20m — Live demo: serving runtime, routing rules, and latency/cost dashboards (me)
3) 10m — Security controls: VPC/private control plane, KMS integration, audit logs (Camila + me)
4) 10m — Q&A & next steps (all)

Tom — to make the session efficient, could you flag any must-see security items (SSO/SAML, data-at-rest encryption, audit log retention windows, any vendor assessment forms you expect)? I’ve attached a short demo agenda PDF and included a link to our security questionnaire in case you want to pre-fill.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-042

Technical notes for the call: we’ll demo a sample 1k-token multi-turn prompt and show automatic KV/prefix caching behavior; we can also show quantization impact if you want to talk cost.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Looping in on the commercial/procurement side.

Julia/Lena/Procurement — quick note on timing and expectations from Redwood’s side:
- Standard PO timeline for Dedicated/Private deployments is ~4–6 weeks after SOW acceptance; enterprise discounts kick in at annual committed usage thresholds (happy to share a draft term sheet after the demo).
- If procurement needs an internal security attestation (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram), we can attach that to the HubSpot deal — link below.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-042

Please confirm who will own the PO and expected legal contact so we can align dates. If Wed 12/23 10:00 PT is confirmed, Camila can send a provisional calendar invite and I’ll prepare a high-level commercial summary to share post-demo.

Thanks,
